title: Automated delegation
modeProductionOnly: The automated delegation only works in production: the Relations Manager does not exist in testing.
waitingPlatform: The platform still has to accept
loginHelp: The company's CUIT or the CUIL of the person who manages its relations in ARCA. If it is a person, the robot picks the company in “Representar a”.
loginInvalid: Check the CUIT or CUIL: the check digit does not match.
consent: I authorize the use of my tax key once to delegate {{services}} to {{platform}} (CUIT {{cuit}}) and create a web service point of sale.
consentHelp: The key is used to sign in to ARCA and is not stored anywhere. If ARCA asks for a captcha or something else, you continue with the guide.
loginRejected: ARCA rejected the CUIT or the tax key. The robot does not try again on its own.

company.point-of-sale: Create the web service point of sale

retryAt: ARCA did not answer. It tries again at {{time}}
platformStopped: The platform has to finish this step by hand; we already let them know.
platformRejected: ARCA did not accept the key of {{platform}}. The robot does not try it again by itself, so that it is not blocked: once it is updated, tap “Try the platform key again”.

stopped.Captcha: The robot stopped: ARCA asked for a captcha. Continue from here with the guide; what came before is already done.
stopped.ExtraValidation: The robot stopped: ARCA asked for an extra validation. Continue from here with the guide; what came before is already done.
stopped.ScreenChanged: The robot stopped: an ARCA screen was not the expected one. Continue from here with the guide; what came before is already done.
stopped.Unavailable: The robot stopped: ARCA did not answer. Try again or continue from here with the guide.
stopped.Interrupted: The robot was interrupted: the server restarted in the middle of the run. Try again or continue from here with the guide.
stopped.LoginRejected: ARCA rejected the CUIT or the tax key.
